description: Automated Wi-Fi Vulnerability Profiling, Risk Assessment, and Security Auditing System with Flask Web UI and Terminal CLI.

app.py.purpose: Flask web server, route controllers, session handling, manual audit modal submission, and report exports (JSON & CSV).

risk_evaluator.py.purpose: Core security risk engine. Implements vulnerability pattern detection, quantitative 0-100 scoring, risk tier classification, and hardening recommendations.

wifi_detector.py.purpose: Hardware telemetry extraction via Windows netsh and live captive portal detection via HTTP probes and SSID heuristics.

auth.py.purpose: User management, registration with constraints, case-insensitive duplicate checking, credential validation, and SHA-256 password hashing.

main.py.purpose: Interactive CLI terminal interface for Wi-Fi auditing, live hardware detection, nearby scanning, manual profile evaluation, and aggregate reporting.

templates.home.html: Landing page with system overview, threat model explanations, workflow breakdown, and CTA.
templates.login.html: Sign In and Sign Up tabbed authentication view.
templates.dashboard.html: Interactive cybersecurity dashboard with live connection monitor, summary statistics, manual audit modal, export controls, and profile cards.

static.css/style.css: Cybersecurity dark monochrome UI styling, modal dialogs, status badges, and typography.
